My article **"Decarbonizing the cement industry in Latin America and the Caribbean"**, co-authored with A. González-Quiroga and O. Pupo-Roncallo, was published in the August 2026 issue of **International Cement Review**.

The article reviews near-term decarbonization options for the region and what it would take to move next-generation projects forward, covering alternative fuels, plant modernization, electrification, and CO₂ infrastructure. A sample of the issue is available [online](https://assets.cemnet.com/sample/magazine/icr-aug-2026-sample/index.html){target="_blank"}.
